metadata.title: Remap Overdrive Knob to Control Modulation Intensity

story.iWant: the overdrive gain knob to additionally control the filter randomization/AM LFO intensity when the toggle is on
story.soThat: I can adjust all effect intensities together while keeping modulation optional
story.tasks: - Analyze current knob implementation - Implement additional knob control for modulation - Connect knob to modulation parameters - Implement smooth transitions - Maintain overdrive independence - Optimize performance - Testing and validation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. When toggle switch OFF: Overdrive gain knob controls overdrive gain and square noise only 2. When toggle switch ON: Overdrive gain knob controls overdrive gain, square noise, AND modulation intensity 3. Smooth transitions when adjusting knob (no stepping artifacts) 4. Knob position correctly interpreted in both modes 5. Audio engine properly applies modulation based on intensity setting 6. No performance degradation from dual-purpose knob logic

artifacts.code: - main.cpp:104-143 - CV knob processing - main.cpp:122-124 - Current jitter_mix_level control - main.cpp:41 - jitter_mix_level variable - main.cpp:22-23 - SquareNoise objects - main.cpp:24-25 - Overdrive objects - main.cpp:13-14 - MIN_OVERDRIVE, MAX_OVERDRIVE constants - main.cpp:14 - NOISE_FACTOR constant - main.cpp:64-75 - KnobOnePoleFilter for smoothing
artifacts.dependencies: - Story 2.2 completion (modulation toggle) - Existing overdrive implementation - Existing square noise implementation - Existing jitter/modulation implementation

story-context.constraints: - Knob always controls overdrive gain and square noise - Modulation intensity only when toggle enabled - Must maintain smooth parameter changes - No performance degradation allowed
story-context.interfaces: - CV knob hardware inputs - Overdrive effect parameters - SquareNoise effect parameters - Jitter modulation parameters - KnobOnePoleFilter for smoothing

tests.standards: - Use sine wave input for clear modulation - Oscilloscope for depth verification - Spectrum analyzer for artifacts - Subjective listening tests
tests.locations: - CV knob processing section - Overdrive parameter application - Noise generation control - Jitter intensity control
tests.ideas: - Test knob in both modes - Full range of knob positions - Rapid mode switching while turning - Verify all three parameters scale - Check for zipper noise - CPU usage profiling
